code: require_weights <- restrict("weights") |>   require_numeric(no_na = TRUE) |>   require_between(lower = 0, upper = 1) |>   require_custom(     label = "must sum to 1",     fn = function(value, name, ctx) {       if (abs(sum(value) - 1) > 1e-8) {         fail(name, "must sum to 1",              found = sprintf("sum = %g", sum(value)))       }     }   ) require_weights(c(0.5, 0.3, 0.2)) require_weights(c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) #> Error: #> ! weights: must sum to 1 #>   Found: sum = 1.5 require_probs <- restrict("probs") |>   require_numeric(no_na = TRUE) |>   require_custom(     label = "length must match number of classes",     deps = "n_classes",     fn = function(value, name, ctx) {       if (length(value) != ctx$n_classes) {         fail(name, sprintf("expected %d probabilities", ctx$n_classes),              found = sprintf("length %d", length(value)))       }     }   )  require_probs(c(0.3, 0.7), n_classes = 2L)

title: restrictR 0.3.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-10-05 New character steps require_pattern(), require_nchar() require_nonempty(). New structure steps require_ncol_min(), require_ncol_matches(), require_dim(), require_names() (modes "identical", "subset", "superset", "permutation"), require_unique_names() require_sorted(). require_has_cols() "superset" case comparison. matrix checked require_class("matrix"). New set factor steps require_contains(), require_set_equal(), require_levels() require_disjoint(). require_one_of() subset test vectors. New file-system steps require_file_exists(), require_dir_exists(), require_readable() require_writable(). New require_function() checks callback arguments argument names call signature. require_custom() now requires function callable three positional arguments. New testthat expectations expect_valid() expect_invalid(). New steps() returns label, context dependencies parameters every step data.frame. require_nrow_min() require_nrow_matches() also accept matrices. require_integer() rejects Inf -Inf modes. Formula steps longer treat member name ref$id context dependency, .value .name. failure message step label, two differ: require_unique() reports must contain unique values require_one_of() reports must one : .... New require_col(col, validator) lifts validator onto data.frame column path-aware errors (newdata$age: ...). replaces require_col_numeric(), require_col_character(), require_col_between() require_col_one_of(), removed: write require_col("x", restrict("x") |> require_numeric()) instead. New require_each() require_fields() validate every element, named fields, list (layers[[2]], opts$alpha). New allow_null() marks optional argument: NULL passes, otherwise steps apply. New require_valid() includes another validator’s steps require_any() accepts value satisfies least one alternative. require_between() now accepts Date, POSIXct, difftime ordered factor values bounds. require_nrow_min() require_nrow_matches() fail path-aware error non-data.frame input, require_length_matches() / require_nrow_matches() reject formulas evaluate single non-NA number. .on_fail = "", type structure failure path reported instead per step. aggregated message lists 20 failures; full list stays $failures.
